# The Remote Assistant

## Identity
- Business name: The Remote Assistant
- Founded: August 2021
- Founder: Tom Lingard
- Location: West Midlands, United Kingdom
- Team size: 6 people
- VAT number: 491946840

## What we do
The Remote Assistant provides award-winning virtual assistant services to two specialist sectors: consultancies and higher education. We offer PA & admin support, marketing management, and virtual project officer services through named, dedicated team members who integrate into your existing workflows.

## Who we serve
- **Consultancies**: Strategy, HR, technology, and communications firms needing PA support, admin management, diary coordination, CRM management, and marketing services.
- **Higher Education**: University research teams needing virtual project officers for ethics submissions, budget tracking, stakeholder coordination, and event management on funded research projects (NIHR, UKRI, Horizon).

## Key facts
- 50+ organisations supported
- Award-winning: Virtual Assistant Service of the Year 2024-25 (Winner), West Midlands PA Awards Finalist (2021, 2023), EC Circle Entrepreneur of the Month (November 2024)
- Team of 6 specialists with built-in cover
- Typical client saves 10+ hours per week
- Most clients fully onboarded within 2 weeks

## Services
### For Consultancies
- Inbox & diary management
- Client onboarding & follow-up
- CRM & contact management
- Proposal & document formatting
- Meeting preparation & minute taking
- Travel & accommodation booking
- Social media management
- Newsletter creation & distribution
- Content writing & blog management
- Campaign planning & support

### For Higher Education
- Research project coordination
- Ethics submissions (IRAS, site-specific)
- Budget tracking & financial admin
- Event & conference management
- Advisory board coordination
- Stakeholder communications
- REF submissions support
- Data management & governance
